invariants.description: Poiseuille resistance and thin-wall compliance: R = 8 mu l/(pi r^4), C = 2 pi r^3 l/(E h), h = r(a e^(b r) + c e^(d r)) (Avolio wall-thickness fit)
exact solution with constant BCs: u(t) = u_ss + (u(0) - u_ss) e^(-t/RC), u_ss = u_out + R v_in, u(0) = q_C_init/C + u_ext
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(u - ((u_out + R*v_in) + ((q_C_init/C + u_ext) - ((u_out + R*v_in)))*np.exp(-t/(R*C))))) <= 1e-6*(np.max(np.abs(u)) + 1.0) + 1e-4*abs(((u_out + R*v_in)) - ((q_C_init/C + u_ext)))

invariants.description: Ohm law at the outlet: v = (u - u_out)/R
volume balance: q_C(t) - q_C(0) = integral of (v_in - v)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_C - q_C[0] - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((v_in - v)[1:] + (v_in - v)[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= (1e-3 + ((t[1] - t[0])/(R*C))**2/6)*np.max(np.abs(q_C - q_C[0])) + 1e-8*np.min(C)*np.max(np.abs(u))

invariants.description: total volume q = q_us + q_C with q_us = pi r^2 l
invariants.expr: np.allclose(q_us, np.pi*r**2*l, rtol=1e-9) & np.allclose(q, q_us + q_C, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

bc_sweep.rationale: BCs span the reference pressure u_0 up to u_0 + 3 dp (dp = test pressure drop of the vessel class) and flows 0 to 3x the equilibrium flow dp/R; u_ext -1000..1000 Pa (tissue pressure); geometry, E, mu and the wall-thickness coefficients at 0.5-2x (the exact solution is re-evaluated at every point, so all invariants must hold across the whole region).

baseline.reason: candidate: Williams1988 human nailfold capillary pressures (arteriolar limb 37.7, apex 19.4, venular limb 14.6 mmHg, steady mean values): a pp/vp capillary between fixed arteriolar- and venular-limb pressures should give the apex pressure; not set up because a single steady value only checks (u_in + u_out)/2 and needs the owner to agree it is a meaningful baseline
